what: A hand-drawn figure (person · car) straddling a section corner sits skewed and transparent. Once its top edge crosses the 25% line from the bottom of the screen, the transparency clears first in .24s and it slides into place at 0° in 1.2s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) — default offset (40%, −3%) · −6°, origin top left. The second figure comes .24s later from (−80%, −20%) · 8°, and the car from (−8%, −2%) · 1° with origin 20% 50%.

options.x · y: Offset while hidden (%, proportional to image size), default 40 · −3
options.zone: Ancestor selector (e.g. section) — measured from when that section enters (the original puts js-inview on the whole section)

from.where: index.html Brand section, two hand drawings (original .nc-top__can__obj.--1·--2) · gallery section car drawing (original .nc-top__gallery__obj.--car)
